dropFramesHint.message: Optional. Keeps the duration at your chosen speed. Duplicate mode merges consecutive identical frames. Automatic size optimization still applies when off.

appDescription.message: Make compact GIFs from selected webpage videos, GIFs and WebP images. Local processing, up to 800 px.

menuScan.message: Choose page media for a GIF…

sourcesHint.message: Choose media here, or right-click it on the page.

emptyHint.message: Open a page, play its video, then right-click it and choose Make a GIF. Animated GIF and WebP images work too.

enableSite.message: Enable video discovery and right-click on this site

siteEnabled.message: Enabled for this site. Reload the page to apply before its player loads.

contextMenuHint.message: Video right-click opens the browser menu. Hold Alt while right-clicking to use the website’s menu. If a site captures right-click, open Gif Toolkit from the toolbar once, then enable this site and reload.

outputNameHint.message: Editable title. Saved filenames use Base64url, a generation timestamp and a unique ID; no spaces or non-ASCII characters.

errorInvalidName.message: Enter a GIF name between 1 and 200 characters.

animationDurationHint.message: The complete animation is selected. Its duration is read before processing.

unknownDuration.message: Play the video to load its duration

speedHint.message: Applies to all selected clips. 1× is normal, 2× is twice as fast, 0.5× is slower.

settingsHint.message: Applies speed, estimates the required dimensions, then optimizes the GIF. Frames are reduced only if resizing and optimization cannot meet the limit. The entire selected range is preserved.

playerNotice.message: Downloads the selected video first. Speed, resizing and GIF optimization run locally without seeking the page player.

tasksHint.message: Processing continues when this panel closes.

tasksEmpty.message: Finished GIFs will appear here, ready to save.

errorInvalidHistory.message: This history record is damaged. Its original data is retained, but it cannot be reused. You can delete this record.

historyProblemsHint.message: Some history records could not be read. Open History to review or delete them.

errorWorkerTimeout.message: Media processing stopped responding. This task was stopped; other queued tasks can continue.

errorSaveFailed.message: The GIF could not be saved. Check browser downloads and try again.

errorInvalidSegment.message: Choose a valid start and end within the media duration.

errorSourceGone.message: The selected player is no longer available. Return to its page and scan again.

errorSourceChanged.message: The page or video changed. Scan the current page to select it again.

errorSourceNotReady.message: Play the source video until a picture appears, pause it, then scan again.

errorProtectedMedia.message: This video uses protected media and cannot be downloaded.

errorCrossOriginPixels.message: This player prevents reading its pixels. This source cannot be processed with the page-player method.

errorSeekFailed.message: The video did not finish seeking. Check that the selected range plays normally, then retry.

errorInputTooLarge.message: The source exceeds this version's processing memory budget. Select a smaller source, shorter clip or smaller dimensions.

errorTooManyFrames.message: A clip can contain up to 600 frames after speed adjustment. Increase speed, lower frame rate or select a shorter clip.

errorDownloadFailed.message: The selected media could not be downloaded. Check its page, network connection and access permissions.

errorPermissionRequired.message: Allow access to the selected media host to download and process it locally.

errorUnsupportedImage.message: This source is not a supported GIF / WebP animation, or its image data is damaged.

errorEncodingFailed.message: The encoder could not finish this source. Try a shorter clip or smaller dimensions.

errorBudgetUnreachable.message: This clip cannot meet the file limit within the quality floor. Increase the limit or choose a shorter clip. No oversized GIF was saved.

errorInterrupted.message: Processing was interrupted when the browser or extension restarted. You can generate the clip again.

errorInvalidOutput.message: The result did not pass frame, size or timing checks. It was not saved as a completed GIF.

errorNoMedia.message: No supported media found. Play the video or load its image, then scan again.

errorPlayerBusy.message: The processing queue or player is busy. Wait for the current task or cancel it.

errorPageUnavailable.message: This page cannot be accessed. Open a regular website and launch Gif Toolkit from its toolbar icon.

errorStorageFull.message: There is not enough local storage. Remove old results to make room.

footer.message: Local processing · No desktop app · Chrome 148+

errorUnsupportedVideo.message: This downloaded video format cannot be decoded by this browser.

chooseMediaResource.message: Choose the stream for this video

mediaResourceHint.message: This page has several streams. Select the one belonging to this video.

errorMediaDiscoveryRequired.message: Enable video discovery for this site, reload the page, play the video briefly and scan again. Its media download session has not been detected.

errorAmbiguousMedia.message: This page has multiple possible video streams. Select the stream belonging to the selected video.

historyHint.message: The latest $COUNT$ finished tasks, saved on this device.

cacheHint.message: Original videos and processing data are released after each task. This space is used by GIFs kept for preview and saving.

clearCacheConfirm.message: Remove $COUNT$ local GIF files ($SIZE$ MB) from this extension? History stays, but these GIFs must be generated again to preview or save. Files already saved to your computer are unaffected.

clearHistoryConfirm.message: Remove these $COUNT$ finished tasks and their stored GIFs? Running tasks, settings and files already saved to your computer are unaffected.

cacheCleared.message: Cleared $COUNT$ files and freed $SIZE$ MB. History was kept.

historyCleared.message: Removed $COUNT$ history records and freed $SIZE$ MB.

fileClearedHint.message: The local GIF has been cleared. Open the source to generate it again.

historyEmpty.message: Your finished tasks will be saved here.

errorResultUnavailable.message: This GIF file is no longer stored here. Open its source page to generate it again.
